word: Title: Afternoon Tasks At The Community Center

answer: Solo queda poco espacio cerca de recepción.

word: I am going to choose the better table.
answer: Voy a elegir la mesa mejor.

word: The worse chairs stay stacked in the corner.
answer: Las sillas peores quedan apiladas en la esquina.

word: The better lights brighten the main hallway.
answer: Las luces mejores iluminan el pasillo principal.

word: The worse bulbs flicker near the back door.

word: We are going to prepare an easy activity.

word: A possible schedule forms on the whiteboard.
answer: Un horario posible se forma en el pizarrón.

word: An impossible deadline appears on the form.

word: The important papers sit ready on the desk.
answer: Los papeles importantes están listos en el escritorio.

word: We are going to print the necessary copies.
answer: Vamos a imprimir las copias necesarias.

word: A true smile spreads across the lobby.
answer: Una sonrisa verdadera se extiende por el vestíbulo.

word: A false rumor moves quietly through volunteers.
answer: Un rumor falso corre silenciosamente entre los voluntarios.

word: The correct box holds the name tags.
answer: La caja correcta tiene los gafetes.

word: The dark hallway leads to the supply room.
